entries.answer: Hi! I'm the Lekopien studio assistant. I can tell you about building a new website, fixing a broken one, pricing and timelines.

questions: can you create a site for my business
entries.answer: We design and build fast, mobile-first websites: landing pages, business sites and online stores. Tell us what your business does and we'll suggest a plan.
We troubleshoot broken, slow or hacked sites. Share the URL and what changed recently, and we'll diagnose it, usually within a day.
A landing page starts small and a full business site costs more depending on pages and features. Describe your project for a free quote.

questions: when will my site be ready
entries.answer: A landing page usually takes 3 to 5 days and a multi-page site 2 to 3 weeks, depending on how quickly content arrives.

questions: where will my site be hosted
entries.answer: We can set up your domain and host your site on reliable free or low-cost platforms such as Cloudflare, with HTTPS included.

questions: will my site show on google
entries.answer: Every site ships with SEO basics: fast loading, clean metadata, a sitemap and Google Search Console setup.
Use the contact form on lekopien.com or book a call there, and a person will reply soon.
Thanks for chatting! Come back any time.
